title: A constructible stratification transfers across etale-local module isomorphisms
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $A$ a finite commutative ring. Work with sheaves of $A_X$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], where $A_X$ is the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $F,G$ be such sheaves and let $(i_\alpha:Z_\alpha\hookrightarrow X)_{\alpha<m}$ be a finite stratification [def-constructible-stratification] witnessing constructibility of $G$ in [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]: its strata are constructible locally closed subsets and each module inverse image $i_\alpha^{-1}G$ is etale locally a constant finite $A$-module sheaf. Suppose there is a jointly surjective etale covering family $\{u_j:U_j\to X\}_{j\in J}$, with no finiteness assumption on $J$, and module-sheaf isomorphisms $u_j^{-1}F\cong u_j^{-1}G$ for every $j$; inverse images use [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then the same stratification witnesses constructibility of $F$: for every $\alpha$, the sheaf $i_\alpha^{-1}F$ is etale locally a constant finite $A$-module sheaf. No compatibility among the local isomorphisms on overlaps is required.

source.place: Tag 03RU, definition-finite-locally-constant, module-sheaf clause; its cover-refinement consequence on a fixed constructible stratification

proof.text: Work throughout in sheaves valued in ModuleCat Λ. The generic inverse-image, composition and restriction comparisons therefore already consist of Λ-linear morphisms; no passage through abelian sheaves or SheafOfModules is needed. Fix k and the given datum d for i^{-1}G. For each chart v_b and supplied model M_b, transport its restriction isomorphism through Etale.overSheafEquiv. The isomorphism overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso identifies the transported restriction with v_b^{-1}i^{-1}G, and constantSheafSheafCongrIso identifies the transported constant sheaf with the constant sheaf of the same M_b. This is chartModelToPullback.

Package the arbitrary J-indexed family as C₀ using Cover.mkOfCovers. Replace C₀ by its point-indexed Cover.ulift C, a Type u covering selecting for each x one original member covering x. This uses choice and hcover, introduces no finiteness assumption, and each selected member retains its supplied local isomorphism. For each b base change C along v_b followed by i, giving R_b=C.pullback₂(v_b ≫ i). Compose with d.cover using Cover.bind. Stability under base change and composition gives a Type u etale covering D of the original stratum.

For each (b,c) let q:W→V_b and r:W→C.X c be the projections of W=C.X c ×_X V_b, and h=q ≫ v_b. The pullback equation gives h ≫ i = r ≫ C.f c. Apply the generic Etale.upperStarComp with coefficient category ModuleCat Λ on either side of this equality to obtain h^{-1}i^{-1}T ≅ r^{-1}(C.f c)^{-1}T for T=F,G. Insert r^{-1} of the supplied selected isomorphism between F and G. Compose with upperStarComp for q and v_b, then q^{-1} of the model of step 1 and upperStarConstantSheafIso. This gives h^{-1}i^{-1}F ≅ constant M_b. All comparisons and mapped isomorphisms are in module-valued sheaf categories.

Reverse the localized-site comparison of step 1: the fully faithful functor of Etale.overSheafEquiv lifts the isomorphism between the transported restriction and transported constant sheaf to an isomorphism (i^{-1}F).over(D_{b,c}) ≅ constant M_b. This is pullbackModelToChart. Keep the given proof that M_b is finite. Each such restriction is constant by Sheaf.isConstant_of_iso, so D and these constantness proofs form LocallyConstantDatum. Pair it with the finite models just constructed and repeat for every k. No new stratification or overlap compatibility is used. Empty X or strata cause no difficulty, since covers and their point-indexed refinements can be empty.
